attacks.name: Hel-Forged Blade
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Claim Soul
steps: After this attack is resolved, if this attack deals |!damage|, this character gains one |<captured_soul>Captured Soul| token.

attacks.name: Rain of Hel
steps: If the defender has the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition, it does not count |!wild| results as successes when defending against this attack.
|!wild| |*Explosive|: Before |!damage| is dealt, other enemy characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Army of Hel
superPowers.body: Spend 1 or more |<captured_soul>Captured Soul| tokens. During the next |*Hel-Forged Blade| or |*Rain of Hel| attack made by this character this Turn, add 1 die to its attack roll for each Captured Soul token that was spent. If a Captured Soul token was spent, after the attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Death‘s Embrace
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3. Advance this character Toward the chosen character |!movement_small|. Then, if this character is within |!range| 1 of the chosen character, roll 4 dice. For each |!critical| and |!wild| in the result, the chosen character suffers 1 |!damage|. For each |!damage| suffered this way, this character may remove 1 |!damage|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Asgardian
superPowers.body: During the Power Phase, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: Goddess of Death
superPowers.body: When another character is Dazed or KO'd this character gains a |<captured_soul>Captured Soul| token. This character may have a maximum of three Captured Soul tokens at any time.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side, and from 4 to 5 on Injured side.
Range for "Hel Forged Blade" increased from 2 to 3.
Power cost for "Claim Soul" decreased from 2 to 1.
Power cost for "Rain of Hell" decreased from 4 to 3.
"Army of Hel" cannot apply to "Claim Soul" anymore.
"Death‘s Embrace" superpower added on Healthy side.
